sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The row counts next to the page heading and each sub-table heading now keep a fixed width. Typing or clearing a filter changes "(20)" to "(3 of 3)/20" and back, but the buttons after the count (Show/Hide all, the ↔️ resize button, the artwork and relationship buttons, …) stay where they are. The width fits the largest text that count can show, so a short count leaves only a small gap.
